standard_reading: Field attribution follows the 802.11ax comment-resolution records 11-19/0099 and 11-19/1137 (for SU feedback in a non-TB sounding the beamformer sets Feedback Type And Ng, Codebook Size and Nc to 0 and the beamformee chooses them; the beamformer dictates them for MU feedback and in TB sounding) and the VHT NDPA STA Info field (Feedback Type, Nc Index; codebook and grouping are the beamformee's, MU feedback uses the MU codebook class). Not checked against the standard's final text.

policies.P2_observed: AP solicits MU feedback from the clients seen returning MU feedback in the capture; the others keep their format
policies.P2_all: AP solicits MU feedback from all six devices
